description: This file contains automated tests for HTTP proxy authentication scenarios in the curl project, implemented using pytest. It defines the class 'TestProxyAuth' with multiple test methods to verify proxy behavior with and without authentication, tunnels, and different protocols.

classes.name: TestProxyAuth
classes.description: A pytest test class that verifies various proxy authentication and tunneling scenarios in the curl HTTP client testing environment.

methods.name: _class_scope(self, env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd)
methods.description: Setup and teardown fixture for configuring proxy auth on the HTTP server for the test class.

methods.name: get_tunnel_proto_used(self, r: ExecResult)
methods.description: Inspects the trace lines from an ExecResult to determine which protocol was negotiated for the tunnel.

methods.name: test_13_01_proxy_no_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, repeat)
methods.description: Tests downloading data via HTTP proxy without authentication, expecting a 407 response.

methods.name: test_13_02_proxy_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, repeat)
methods.description: Tests downloading data via HTTP proxy with authentication, expecting a 200 response.

methods.name: test_13_03_proxys_no_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, repeat)
methods.description: Tests HTTPs proxy without auth, expecting a 407, skipped if feature not supported.

methods.name: test_13_04_proxys_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, nghttpx_fwd, repeat)
methods.description: Tests HTTPS proxy with authentication, expecting 200.

methods.name: test_13_05_tunnel_http_no_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, repeat)
methods.description: Tests tunneling through HTTP proxy without auth, expecting connection failure (exit code 56).

methods.name: test_13_06_tunnel_http_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, repeat)
methods.description: Tests tunneling through HTTP proxy with auth, expecting success (200).

methods.name: test_13_07_tunnels_no_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, proto, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Tests HTTPS tunnels with different protocols without auth, expects connection failure and verifies protocol used.

methods.name: test_13_08_tunnels_auth(self, env: Env, httpd, proto, tunnel, repeat)
methods.description: Tests HTTPS tunnels with different protocols with auth, expects success and verifies negotiated protocol.
